reference_review: Downloaded as MP4; 2.60 seconds, 1024 square, 10fps. Inspected original 0.25/1.25/2.25 second frames: fireball -> rolling mushroom -> brown smoke. Original reference pixels are not shipped.
generation_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production videogame VFX sprite animation atlas, transparent RGBA, 1536x1024, exactly SIX columns and FOUR rows =24 frames, each frame a 256x256 square. Primary request: a new fluid natural mushroom-shaped explosion cloud that develops smoothly and never shakes or jumps sideways. Warm orange/yellow volumetric fireball rapidly rolls upward into a cauliflower mushroom cap with a narrow central stem, then becomes billowing dark warm brown smoke and dissipates. No characters, objects, terrain, UI or scene. Camera fixed elevated orthographic 2.5D RTS view. All24 frames use exactly the same camera, pixel scale and ground origin: x=128 y=224 within EACH256x256cell. The ground origin and vertical center axis must be identical in every frame. The cloud grows by physically expanding from that origin, NEVER by moving or resizing the entire image. Temporal sequence left to right then next row: frames1-4 small brilliant ignition into rounded orange fireball; frames5-8 fireball lifts and rolls into rising mushroom; frames9-12 mature bright boiling mushroom cap and coherent central fire/smoke stem; frames13-18 fire cools progressively into warm brown gray dense billowing mushroom; frames19-24 smoke thins, edges soften and opacity falls while the axis and ground anchor remain locked. No lateral drift or wind. Crisp readable realistic volumetric turbulent puffs, natural warm highlights, deep orange internal folds and brown soot, no cartoon outlines, no radial starburst spikes. Keep every stage inside its own cell with at least16px transparent clearance on left/right/top. Mature cap maximum width210px height195px. No labels, grids, borders, white backdrop, checkerboard painted pixels, missiles, weapons, people, buildings or ground plates. True transparent background including between cells. This is harmless fictional game VFX on empty transparent space.
cleaning_prompt: Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit. Edit this EXACT 1536x1024 six-column four-row 24-frame explosion-cloud VFX atlas. Preserve the exact 24 cloud shapes, timing order, positions, sizes, cell layout, details and colors. ONLY remove the broad flat brown haze/background and the little solid ground/rubble patches at the foot of each cloud. Keep the actual billowing fire and mushroom smoke including soft translucent smoke edges; leave each cloud's narrow central stem. All empty space outside each cloud must become truly alpha=0 transparent, including cell corners/gaps, never opaque black/white or a painted checkerboard. No rectangular fog panel around any frame. Do not redraw clouds, do not move frames, do not add text, borders or terrain. Genuine clean RGBA sprite cutouts on transparent background, not an image of sprites on a background.
registration: 24 per-frame sampling offsets, shared pivot/scale; original explosion and missile sprites preserved.
